inScope: Maintain, search, archive, export, and audit equipment records

evidence.claim: Three coordinators maintain fewer than 20,000 equipment records with archive, search, CSV, and one-year audit needs
evidence.falsifiedBy: The stakeholder changes the operating scope or load target

evidence.claim: The supplied requirements do not decide concurrent-edit behavior
evidence.falsifiedBy: An authorized concurrency policy is supplied

unresolvedQuestions.question: What happens when two coordinators edit the same item?
unresolvedQuestions.consequence: The write contract cannot yet promise conflict or overwrite behavior

subsystems.name: Equipment administration
subsystems.purpose: Maintain and retrieve independent equipment records

rule_change_complexity.rationale: Rules are record-local validation and visibility rules

invariant_criticality.rationale: Uniqueness and audit obligations are important but not safety critical

dataflow_orientation.rationale: CSV is a direct filtered projection, not a transformation pipeline

autonomy_uncertainty.rationale: All behavior is deterministic and user initiated

integration_volatility.rationale: No external provider behavior is in scope

scale_performance.rationale: Fewer than 20,000 records and ordinary weekday use

assurance_governance.rationale: Authorization and one-year change history require explicit assurance

change_isolation.rationale: One small tool and one maintaining developer are expected

qualityScenarios.stimulus: An authorized coordinator submits a valid equipment edit
qualityScenarios.artifact: One equipment record and its audit history
qualityScenarios.response: The record changes atomically and the actor and time are appended
qualityScenarios.measure: One accepted transaction and one matching audit entry
